inspection.finding: The notation contains simultaneous noteheads/chords, tied lyric spacing and an isolated stemmed note between chords. Treating successive visually picked notehead x coordinates as one-to-one with successive printed lyric fragments is not a valid pairing rule.
inspection.implication: System 2's cluster of positive horizontal deltas cannot be corrected by shifting each lyric to the indexed candidate. Need score-event grouping and assignment by printed glyph-to-note vertical relationship, with voice and duration accounted for.

inspection.finding: Final phrase flagged as a cluster. Candidate x values were indexed sequentially without proof that every note/chord onset corresponds to exactly one lyric fragment.

reviewRules: Confirm printed Malayalam fragment visually, not by automatic OCR
Locate the notehead or chord onset for each printed lyric; record noteheadX and pitch from the score
If one syllable spans multiple notes, record the additional noteheads and melisma explicitly
Preserve exact locked Manglish source; never modify transcription merely to fit notes
Verify phrase/system breaks against notation, not equal word allocation
Do not mark noteVerified or syllableVerified until evidence recorded
limitations: Crop transform is confirmed by template matching. Candidate notehead locations were manually approximated, and some are substantially offset from printed lyric positions. The candidate-to-fragment pairing itself has not been established musically. No notehead, pitch, duration or melisma is verified.
